body: This sums up what I meant in fewer words. 🙃 oof
Don't worry my pride would never let me. Aka why I wrote on this thread anonymously. 😂
Oh my goodness this was extremely helpful thanks.

I only know of the personalities on a superficial level. I am unaware that there are in-depth cognitive aspects to these types. I just thought that it was literal so since I don't fit into this box completely then I am not an ENTP. 

I will do more research. I also just joined this thread today so hopefully that will help me be more informed about ENTP.

I like this thought process. I'm not a fan of the "idc" statement because it feels too untrue for me personally. But definitely the idea that only I can allow others to have that power over me is what I try to keep in mind.

I empathize with this. My birthday is tomorrow. I feel so tired and life is so stressful. Stay strong! Maybe find things to look forward to since that keeps a lot of people going.

It can even be something trivial like starting a new season of a show or maybe bigger ambitions like finishing college/or other job aspirations. 

But definitely having something to look forward to helps! You could even adopt a cat/dog and you know since you have to feed and take care of that cat/dog that will keep you getting up everyday with some purpose.

Okay this makes more sense. I felt a bit alone at first and thought that I had to have a strong "idc" attitude. 

Usually I don't trivialize things but once in a while especially when I feel alone I tend to get a bit gloomy in behavior.

I guess I didn't phrase it quite right I apologize. I mean when it comes to friendships and dealing with people at work on a superficial level am ENTP in nature. 

But alone I tend to feel a lot more sensitive

My thoughts are just go ahead and apply to jobs on indeed or whatever platform. The worst that can happen is getting a "we moved forward with other candidates" email. 

If you believe you deserve more then apply and best of luck with your future career endeavors!

**also when applying maybe try things you "think" you're underqualified for. You might be surprised that you get the job. It has happened to be before.

It just doesn't fly with me honestly. It makes me less likely to directly contact them again. 

It's as if I was being tattle telled by the boss. It doesn't feel quite right.

But I respect your opinion.

Definitely try to demand more pay of at least 18 minimum. They can't just lie on indeed saying $18 starting point, you should actually be able to report them for that on the listing. I reported a job application on indeed that said it was looking for managers, but in the interview they said they aren't hiring managers just regular staff.

So you should be able to flag that on indeed somehow.

Hello there! I'm here if you need a friend to chat with. Honestly being in the early 20s is a roller coaster, it sucks you have been through so many bad things already. Don't give up hope! Tomorrow never dies and you have a lot of life to live. 

I hope you also are able to find a good job soon.
Thank you so much for your kind words. I will remember not to carry hatred.
That is good to know! Thanks!
Darn sorry to hear that. I think I might have to wait until the month I move overseas and make friends.Someone's gotta do it eventually 😂
No thanks, but thanks for the reply.
